sections.sectionText: Introduction to Persian, including a conversation with a native speaker under the direction of a linguist-instructor and a minimum of formal grammar and writing.

subject: PERS
title: Intermediate Persian I
info: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PERS 202.

sections.sectionText: General review of the essentials of grammar, selected reading of materials emphasizing Iranian life and culture, compositions, and practice in speech. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PERS 202

subject: PERS
title: Advanced Persian I
info: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PERS 403 and PERS 404; or consent of Persian Studies Program Director (determined after placement test taken by student).

sections.sectionText: Students will develop the ability to read and understand paragraph-level text, expand on their oral skills, continue to refine Persian writing skills and expand their knowledge of Persian-speaking cultures. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PERS 403 and PERS 404 or consent of the Persian Studies Program Director (determined after placement test taken by a student).
